description: React component for displaying server logs with date filtering, using various UI components and APIs.

classes.name: DatePickerCustomInput
classes.description: Custom input component for date picker, styled as a button.

methods.name: getDateBefore
methods.description: Calculates a date before the current date based on units and value.

methods.name: subtractTime
methods.description: Subtracts months, days, and hours from current date and returns formatted string.

methods.name: handleTimeSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles change in selected time range and fetches logs accordingly.

methods.name: onStartDateSelected
methods.description: Updates start date and fetches logs for the selected range.

methods.name: onEndDateSelected
methods.description: Updates end date and fetches logs for the selected range.
